title: Drone Pairs

examples.explanation: The pairs are (1, 5) at positions 1 and 2, and (3, 3) at positions 3 and 4. The 7 has no partner because 6 − 7 = −1 isn't in the list.
Any two of the four 5s make 10, and there are 4 · 3 / 2 = 6 ways to choose two of them.

hints: Fix the parcel that comes second in a pair. Which weight must the first parcel have?
As you scan left to right, you only need to know how many earlier parcels had each weight. Which structure answers "how many times have I seen x?" in O(1)?
The answer can be as large as n(n − 1)/2 ≈ 2·10^10, and a_i + a_j can reach 2·10^9. Check which of your variables need 64 bits.
